assumptions: long values are modelled as the integers 0..6.
println is not modelled: it does not communicate.
Every par branch is a CSP process synchronising only on the channels it shares; a par ends (τ) when all its branches have.

steps.description: prefix writes its initial 0 on d; delta reads it
delta's branch 2 writes 0 on b; succ reads it
delta's branch 1 writes 0 on a; consume reads it (1 of 3)
succ writes 1 on c; prefix reads it
delta's par ends; delta starts its next round
prefix writes 1 on d; delta reads it
delta's branch 2 writes 1 on b; succ reads it
succ writes 2 on c; prefix reads it
delta's branch 1 writes 1 on a; consume reads it (2 of 3)
delta's par ends; delta starts its next round
prefix writes 2 on d; delta reads it
delta's branch 1 writes 2 on a; consume reads it (3 of 3) and then finishes
delta's branch 2 writes 2 on b; succ reads it
delta's par ends; delta starts its next round
succ writes 3 on c; prefix reads it
prefix writes 3 on d; delta reads it
delta's branch 2 writes 3 on b; succ reads it
succ writes 4 on c; prefix reads it

final.description: branch 1 of delta waits to write 3 on a

partner.detail: consume read its three values and finished

final.description: branch 2 of delta wrote 3 on b and finished
delta waits for its par to finish (its branch 1 is stuck), so it never reads d again

waits.detail: waits for its par to finish

partner.detail: branch 1 of delta is stuck writing a
delta never starts the par that writes b: it waits for its current par to finish

final.description: prefix waits to write 4 on d

partner.detail: delta waits for its par to finish instead of reading d

final.description: consume finished after reading three values

counterexample.summary: deadlock after 18 steps: branch 1 of delta waits to write a, but consume has terminated; delta, succ and prefix all wait on delta
